prior_conversation._comment: A long prior conversation (24 turns) seeded before the demo run, so the context-budget slice is under real pressure and the model must not be re-asked facts stated here. Turn 5 states an area; turn 9 states a budget; turn 14 corrects the area once; turn 21 states an earliest time.

turns.text: Hi, I need some help around the flat this month.
Happy to help. What needs doing first?
The kitchen tap has been dripping for a week.
A plumber can usually sort a dripping tap in one visit. Which area are you in?
Indiranagar, near the 100 Feet Road end.
Noted - Indiranagar. Any preference on when?
Mornings work better for me.
Understood: mornings.
And I do not want to spend more than about fifteen hundred for the tap job.
Fifteen hundred ceiling for the plumbing job, noted.
Also the bedroom AC makes a rattling noise.
That is usually a loose fan mount or debris in the housing. Worth a service.
Yes, but let us deal with the tap first.
Agreed. I will keep the AC service for a later turn.
Actually make that Koramangala - I am at my sister's place for the next two weeks.
Updated to Koramangala. The fifteen hundred ceiling still stands for the tap.
Right. And only weekdays, I am not around at weekends.
Weekdays only, noted.
One more thing - the last electrician left the switchboard loose.
I can get that looked at. Same area and time preferences apply.
Nothing earlier than ten in the morning, I am not up before then.
Understood: nothing before 10:00.
Ok. Let us start with the tap when you are ready.
Ready when you are. I will confirm the provider, slot and price before anything is booked.
